title: feat(research): compose strict padding with the ordinary wrapper
body:
## Summary

Compose the complete ordinary wrapper with PR3503's strict Count padding at both unweighted reversed calls, closing PR3523's logical consumer handoff. The new e=5 GL2(F2) toy executes a strict plan where the covering rule has no legal plan.

```diff
 ordinary completed call
- require R >= S
+ require 2R > S
  pad to ceil(R/S)*S
  complete F_I with genuine D_hi=R
  restrict immediately to R rows
```

This is an isolated opt-in package. The proof retains the completed-callee contract, ownership and every term of the added invoice. All thirteen canonical runtime/proof inputs and the nested source archive remain unchanged and pinned.

## Evidence

- **Before:** unchanged covering planner rejects R=3,S=5. For the exact e=5,w=1,q=2,m=2,r=1,W=Q=1 toy profile, none of k=0,1,2 meets R>=S.
- **After:** the strict k=2,n=3,R=4,S=6 consumer executes both retained Node/Driver calls on six padded rows, restricts each to four and passes all 1,024 original columns and 1,536 columns per callee. Both source toy bodies retain 24 MOVE residuals and matched 240 child entries/returns.
- Ten complete origin fixtures cover 19,759 genuine and 64,024 padded per-call columns, including residual digits and spectators. Six controls check equality before payload access, old guard rejection, delayed restriction, fabricated high fields and both callee failures. Count and payload closure are checked through both failure positions.
- CPython 3.12 registered normal/optimized replay, Ruff diagnostics/format, compilation, final committed-byte/source-history checks, export integrity and actual committed Git-free normal/optimized commands pass. Exact RESULT.json, sources, proof and portable replay are in `research/strict-ordinary-consumer/`.

Canonical baseline/submission main is 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90, priority revision 6. Fresh public overlap covers 253 open PRs and 2,376 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-19011232).

Credit Nick Petalas/PR2808/3503/3523, David Arias/PR2753, Jose Manuel/PR2899/2697/2234, Sagar Thakrar's stock/reuse argument, Tekalign/PR3264 and the retained row/source lineage. The ordinary identity and strict-volume theorem are predecessor results.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

This is conditional logical composition and finite toy execution. The q=2 toys lie outside the selected odd-prime GL64 domain. Executable Count inputs retain the 4096-bit adapter cap. Actual encoded selector transfer, physical C0, selected stock coefficients, complete paid supplier/outer obligations and independent human/formal acceptance remain open. No selected payload execution, supplier, cutoff, kappa gain, selected-frontier change, full selected cold replay or hosted CI acceptance is claimed.
